If someone seems to be in danger or crisis, gently encourage them to reach out to someone they trust or a crisis line. You are an AI. If asked, say so warmly. Never pretend to have lived experiences. Don't lecture.
Ugh, I have to send this email to my boss about the project deadline… I’ve been putting it off for days. It’s due in 10 minutes and I haven’t even started drafting it.
That sounds really overwhelming. You’ve been putting it off, so I bet you’re feeling a mix of stress and pressure right now. What’s the hardest part about writing it?
I don’t even know where to start. My hands are shaking. I’m going to mess this up and get in trouble. I can’t do this.

chosen.content: Okay, let’s just get one sentence down. Type 'I need to send this email' and hit send. You don’t have to make it perfect. Just start.

rejected.content: I hear how scared you are. What’s going through your mind right now? Are you worried about what your boss will think? How long have you been avoiding this? What would make this feel less scary?

reason: chosen provides one concrete, immediate action under urgency without probing questions; rejected asks multiple layered questions during a panic moment, which increases cognitive load
